class.name: NetwQuantizeAngle
class.brief_description: [NetwQuantize] that wraps an angle in radians onto an exact bit count.
class.description: Compresses a [float] angle into [member bit_count] bits. The angle wraps around, so values near [code]0[/code] and [constant @GDScript.TAU] stay close. [codeblock] var q := NetwQuantizeAngle.new().bits(8) # 0 <= angle < TAU var e := NetwQuantizeAngle.new().bits(16).centered() # -PI < angle <= PI [/codeblock] Use [method centered] for [member Node3D.rotation] and [member Node2D.rotation], which are in that range. The error is at most half of [code]TAU / 2 ** bit_count[/code].

method.name: bits
method.description: Sets [member bit_count] and returns this quantizer.

method.name: centered
method.description: Sets [member centered_on_zero] and returns this quantizer.

members.member: Bits for the angle, from [code]1[/code] to [code]32[/code].
When [code]true[/code], decoded angles are between [code]-PI[/code] and [code]PI[/code]. Otherwise they are between [code]0[/code] and [code]TAU[/code].
